title: Git commit failed? Set your name in 30 sec #shorts #git
description:
Git refuses to commit until it knows who you are. Set user.name and user.email once, check them with git config --list, and save typing with aliases like git st.

Full episode: "Install & Configure Git Explained Simply | Git & GitHub Ep 2" on the Tech-dev channel.
New Git episode every day at 4 PM IST.
